decision: Resume Firecrawl after proven pre-job local transport failure; one corrected upload recovery for A01-A04, initial attempts for A05-B10.
basis: Four phase-one setup responses succeeded; local closed-stdin bug prevented every HTTP upload and every final parse call. PTY transport repaired and synthetic 99019-byte transfer verified exact without echo. No Firecrawl content result exists, so no sample/output-driven replacement.
constraints: Original attempt records and local failure-stop history retained.
Use a new run directory; same immutable corpus, references and parser settings.
At most two concurrent final parses; reset failure counter only for this explicitly repaired transport phase, then stop again after three failures.
No retry of any uncertain submitted parse; no extra pre-job retry for an affected input.
Report local harness failures separately from vendor availability and content metrics; include setup overhead transparently.
scope_change: Execution recovery only. No reference, corpus, content-scoring or arm-setting change.
